column3: “Matters” is rendered “acts,” and “found on him” as “found against him.”
“The return of the year” is rendered “the turn of the year,” and “articles of preciousness” as “valuable articles.” “Relative” is rendered “kinsman.”
“From the mouth of Yahweh” is rendered “who spoke for the LORD.”
“Made him swear” is rendered “made him swear allegiance,” and “from turning back” as “against turning.”
“Leaders” is rendered “officials,” and “increased to act unfaithfully unfaithfulness” as “were very unfaithful.”
“Rising early and sending” is rendered “again and again”; NASB supplies “word.”
“Young woman” is rendered “virgin,” and “decrepit” as “infirm.” NASB supplies “them.”
“Palaces” is rendered “fortified buildings,” and “to destroy” as “destroyed.”
“The remainder from the sword” is rendered “those who had escaped from the sword,” and “slaves” as “servants.”
“Caused to pass a proclamation” is rendered “sent a proclamation”; NASB supplies “put it.”
